hard_disqualifiers: CHAIN / FRANCHISE / CORPORATE-OWNED: name matches the CHAIN_HINTS regex in voice-ai-demo-builder/src/leads/places.js; OR 25+ locations (count distinct Google Maps pins for the brand, or a 'Find a location' / 'Franchise opportunities' page); OR the business is a franchisee of any national brand even at one unit (the franchisor controls marketing; one Roto-Rooter is still Roto-Rooter); OR it is publicly traded or owned by a private-equity / holding / DSO / MSO / dealer group ('a [Group] company', 'part of the X family of brands', SOS parent entity). Evidence: Google Maps pin count, website footer, state SOS registry, '[brand] franchise' search.

NO WORKING OWN-DOMAIN WEBSITE: Google Places has no websiteUri (places.js already skips these), or the URL returns 4xx/5xx, is parked, for sale, 'under construction', or SSL has been dead for weeks; or the only web presence is a Facebook/Instagram page, Linktree, Yelp/Thumbtack/Angi listing, or a marketplace storefront (Amazon/Etsy-only). The voice demo builder and the GEO audit both scrape a real site; no site means no door-opener.

NOT A LIVE U.S. BUSINESS: no U.S. address or service area; Google Business Profile 'Permanently closed' or 'Temporarily closed' / status not OPERATIONAL; state registry dissolved, revoked, or forfeited; public notice the business is for sale, in bankruptcy, closing, 'not taking new clients', or license revoked; or zero public activity (no new review, social post, GBP post, or site change) in 18+ months AND the listed phone is disconnected.

NO INBOUND CUSTOMER CHANNEL TO AUTOMATE: no phone number anywhere (site, GBP, Yelp, Facebook) AND no contact form, chat, booking, quote, or consult flow anywhere. Phone-less is allowed only when a form/chat/booking flow exists (e.g. ecommerce with a support line or consult form); phone-less AND form-less means there is nothing for E4L to fix. Covers cart-only ecommerce, wholesale-only, pure content sites, walk-in-only retail.

COMPETITOR OR NON-BUYER CATEGORY: marketing / SEO / web design / ad agency, AI or software vendor, AI receptionist or chatbot vendor, answering service, call center; government body, public school, church, nonprofit with no sales function; pure B2B wholesaler with no inbound inquiry flow; MLM, adult, gambling, payday lending; and wrong-industry Places hits (e.g. a roofing supply yard returned for 'roofing').

ALREADY AUTOMATED ON BOTH FRONTS: a competing AI phone agent is confirmed by name (site, page source, job post, review, 'powered by' badge: Smith.ai AI, Goodcall, Dialzara, Rosie, Slang.ai, Sameday, Avoca, Voctiv, 'our AI receptionist') AND the business is already named in 3+ of the AI spot-check answers or has FAQPage/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with a credited SEO/GEO vendor. One front alone is NOT a disqualifier: a confirmed AI receptionist alone zeroes D2 and flags the row 'GEO wedge only'; a human answering service is scored, not rejected.

ALREADY IN E4L'S WORLD OR DO-NOT-CONTACT: matches an existing contact in the GHL 'E4L Services' sub-account by domain, phone, or business name + city (check with voice-ai-demo-builder/src/leads/ghl-contacts.js, never by name alone); is a current or former E4L client or in a geo/audits/ or demo-pool folder already worked; was emailed or called by E4L in the last 90 days (Sheet 'Sent' tab); previously replied 'no' / 'remove me' / unsubscribed; or the site, GBP, or Yelp carries an explicit 'no solicitation', 'no vendors', 'we do not accept marketing calls' notice. Dedupe runs BEFORE any research so no time is spent on these.

dimensions.name: D1. Decision-maker identified and directly reachable (owner dossier)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Find the person who signs the check and a channel to reach them, public sources only. Only the listed values are allowed. 20 = owner / founder / principal / managing partner / DDS-MD owner / broker-owner full name AND role cited from at least one authoritative public source (About or Team page, state SOS registry, state license board, BBB principal, LinkedIn 'Owner at', Yelp 'Meet the Owner', GBP reply signed with name and title; two independent sources preferred and both URLs recorded) AND a direct email belonging to that person on the website domain published on a public page (site, PDF brochure, BBB, Yelp, LinkedIn contact panel, license record) OR an owner direct line / cell posted publicly, PLUS one secondary channel (owner LinkedIn URL, owner social handle, or a second phone distinct from the main line). 14 = full name + role cited AND one of: a personal-pattern email published with no secondary channel; owner LinkedIn + staffed main line with only a generic monitored mailbox (info@, office@, contact@); or an email-finder result (hunter.js, DECISION_MAKER-title match) at confidence >= 80, recorded as 'hunter NN - verify before send'. 8 = full name cited but contact is a generic mailbox or form only; OR a role proxy (office manager, practice manager, GM) is the only named person and a published email exists; OR first name only ('ask for Mike') corroborated by a review or signed reply plus a staffed main line; OR email-finder result at confidence 60-79 (verify before send). This level is the call-first (Sam) or DEMO PATH route, not the email route. 3 = no person named anywhere but a generic published email and a staffed main line exist. 0 = no name and no email (CAPTCHA form only), the only named person has demonstrably left (LinkedIn shows a new employer), names conflict across sources and cannot be resolved in budget, the main number rings to a national call center or voicemail-only, or the only email comes from an uncorroborated scraper site. HARD RULES: never pattern-generate an email into the email column; a suspected pattern goes only in 'pattern_guess_unverified', earns 0, and is never sent to. A suspected name goes in 'unconfirmed_name', not 'owner_name'. Record the name source URL and the email source URL separately. ALSO CAPTURE (not scored, for Chosen's personal outreach): first-name spelling the owner uses in review replies, second decision-maker (spouse, partner, office manager), years as owner, prior business, and anything the owner has said publicly about marketing, phones, or AI (press, podcast, review replies); write 'not found' where nothing was found. Vertical hit rates (trades 60-80%, real estate 70-80%, law 50-60%, dental/medical 40-50%, restaurants 30-40%, med spa/salon ~15%) are context, never a reason to lower the bar: a med spa or salon with a named owner and no email is flagged DEMO PATH and routed call-first / live-demo, not rejected.
evidence_sources: Website About / Team / Meet the Owner / Contact pages, footer, mailto: links, signed blog posts, and any linked PDF (brochure, price sheet, menu) - what voice-ai-demo-builder/src/leads/scrape-light.js already captures
State Secretary of State business entity search (officers, members, managers, registered agent); OpenCorporates

State license lookups: contractor board (CSLB in CA, TDLR in TX, DBPR in FL), cosmetology, medical / dental / nursing board, state bar, real estate commission, DMV dealer license (licensee name, often a direct phone or email)
Google Business Profile 'From the owner' posts and owner replies signed with a name and title
Yelp 'Meet the Business Owner'; BBB profile 'Business Management' / principal contacts
LinkedIn company page -> People tab; owner profile headline and 'Contact info' panel

Email finder / domain search (voice-ai-demo-builder/src/leads/hunter.js) with confidence score; prefer DECISION_MAKER titles (owner, founder, ceo, president, principal, partner, director, managing, proprietor, md)
Facebook page About (email, phone) and Contact button target; Instagram bio and 'Email' action button
Local news, chamber of commerce directory, award pages, podcast or YouTube appearances
A second phone number on the site, truck wraps in GBP photos, or Yelp that differs from the GBP main line (often the owner's cell)

dimensions.name: D2. Phone-coverage and after-hours gap (voice receptionist fit)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Is the phone where the money comes in, and is it going unanswered? 15 = phone-first (number in site header or hero, primary CTA is 'Call for a quote / estimate / appointment', or GBP 'Call' is the main action) AND at least one cited gap proof: (a) GBP hours show closed on 2+ evenings or weekend days while the business advertises emergency, urgent, same-day, or 24/7 service, OR the niche is inherently urgent (plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical, garage door, pest, locksmith, restoration, towing, vet, PI law, auto service); (b) site / GBP / Facebook text says 'leave a message', 'we'll call you back', 'messages returned next business day', or lists phone hours narrower than service hours; (c) no mention anywhere (site, GBP, Yelp, Facebook, page source) of 24/7 answering, an answering service, a call center, or an AI receptionist. 9 = phone-first but hours are extended (open 7 days or past 8pm) with no 24/7 claim; OR an after-hours line or human answering service is mentioned but not confirmed 24/7; OR an appointment-driven business (dental, med spa, law, real estate) lists the phone in the header but the primary CTA is a form or booking link. 4 = phone exists only on the Contact page or footer; OR booking runs primarily through a third-party platform (Booksy, OpenTable, Zocdoc, Vagaro) so calls are secondary; OR a human live-answering service is credited (Ruby, Smith.ai live, AnswerConnect, Nexa, PATLive, Moneypenny) - the voice pitch becomes a cost-replacement conversation, note it. 0 = site or GBP states the business's own staff answer live 24/7; OR a competing AI phone agent is confirmed (also flag 'GEO wedge only'); OR there is no phone number at all (ecommerce / form-only: D3 and D4 carry the lead, recommended offer becomes speed-to-lead + GEO + AI-readable FAQ schema, and 'demo_build = no'). Record the exact GBP hours string and the exact sentence that proves the gap, with URLs. Check the existing Voice AI demo pool so a demo is not rebuilt for a business already demoed.
evidence_sources: Google Business Profile: hours, 'More hours' / emergency hours, 'Call' button, attributes, Q&A, messaging on/off
Website header, hero, footer, Contact page, any 'Emergency' or 'After hours' page; page source for answering-service or AI-voice vendor scripts
Yelp business page hours and phone block; Facebook page About and 'Send message' auto-reply text
Niche urgency list above (cite which row applies)
Existing GHL Voice AI demo pool / demo-builder output list (confirm not already demoed)
Sam records 'who answered' (human, service, IVR, AI, voicemail) on the first call; that updates this dimension after outreach, never during research

dimensions.name: D3. Lead-response leak evidence (reviews, hiring, reply neglect, booking friction)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Count DISTINCT signal types from the last 18 months, each with a URL and quoted text; never paraphrase a review into a stronger claim. Signal types: (1) a Google / Yelp / BBB / Facebook review containing responsiveness complaints: 'never called back', 'no one answered', 'left a voicemail', 'took days to respond', 'couldn't get through', 'no reply to my email/form', 'had to call three times' - quote verbatim with date; (2) a job post within 180 days on Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Craigslist, Facebook Jobs, or the site's Careers page for receptionist, front desk, CSR, dispatcher, scheduler, office manager, 'answer phones', or appointment setter (they are paying for exactly what the AI receptionist does); (3) owner replies to fewer than 25% of the 20 newest Google reviews, or 50%+ of 1-3 star reviews in the last 12 months have no reply, or the last reply is more than 6 months old; (4) Yelp 'Response time' of 'about a day' or slower, Yelp 'Request a quote' response rate under 80%, or GBP messaging off / no 'usually responds' badge; (5) booking and contact friction: no online scheduling of any kind AND no chat / text-us widget AND the contact form gives no response-time promise or auto-confirmation - verify in page source for vendor scripts (calendly, acuity, housecallpro, servicetitan, jobber, vagaro, mindbody, booksy, zocdoc, nexhealth, square, opentable, podium, birdeye, tidio, intercom, drift, tawk, livechat, textline, weave), not by eyeballing the page; (6) a BBB complaint citing non-response. 15 = 3+ distinct signal types including at least one of (1) or (2). 10 = exactly 2 signal types; OR (1) alone with 2+ quoted reviews dated within 12 months. 5 = exactly 1 signal type; OR responsiveness complaints exist but are older than 18 months; OR unanswered negative reviews exist but none mention phone or response. 0 = none of the six found after checking all listed sources (log the null with the sources checked); OR reviews actively praise responsiveness ('answered right away', 'called back in 10 minutes') and the owner replies promptly to nearly all negatives; OR the site has online booking in the header AND live chat or text AND an instant auto-reply. Record the single strongest signal in 'strongest_pain_signal' - it picks the opener and the door-opener (missed-call quote or receptionist job post = live voice demo; friction only = Revenue Leak Scorecard). ECOMMERCE substitute signals: unanswered product questions in reviews or Q&A, no support phone or chat response commitment, 'contact us' with no stated turnaround, abandoned-cart or shipping-question complaints.
evidence_sources: Google reviews sorted by Lowest and by Newest; in-review search for 'call', 'phone', 'voicemail', 'respond', 'answer', 'email', 'schedule', 'never heard back'; owner reply rate on the 20 newest
Yelp reviews including 'not currently recommended'; Yelp 'Response time' / 'Response rate' badges and 'Request a quote' button
BBB profile: complaints tab, rating, years in business
Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs, ZipRecruiter, Craigslist, Facebook Jobs, site Careers page: '[business name] receptionist', '[business name] office', '[business name] dispatcher'
Website home and Contact page plus page source for booking / chat / text vendor scripts; GBP 'Book' / 'Appointments' button; Facebook 'Book Now' CTA
Facebook page posts and comments, Nextdoor recommendations, Reddit local subs for 'anyone used [business]' threads

dimensions.name: D4. AI search visibility gap (GEO) - the free-audit seed
dimensions.scoring_guide: First check geo/audits/ so a business already audited is not re-run. Pick 3 of the 7 money questions from geo/money-questions/<niche>.json with [city] filled in. For an off-list niche write 3 analogous questions in the same form ('<urgent service> near <City, ST>', 'most reliable <niche> in <City, ST>', '<niche> that answers the phone <City, ST>'). For ECOMMERCE use product-recommendation questions ('best <product> for <use case>', 'where to buy <product> online') instead of 'near <city>'. Ask each question on at least 2 of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini in fresh logged-out sessions = 6 answers; record the platform, whether the business is named, and which competitors are named. Then view page source for 'application/ld+json' with FAQPage / LocalBusiness / Service schema. 10 = named in 0 of 6 while at least one direct local competitor is named, AND no FAQPage or LocalBusiness JSON-LD on the site. 6 = named in 1-2 of 6; OR named in 0 of 6 but the site already has FAQ content or schema; OR only one platform could be checked (minimum 3 answers) and the business was not named there. 2 = named in 3-4 of 6 but no schema (AI-readable-site pitch only). 0 = named in 5+ of 6; OR an AI / GEO / SEO vendor is credited on the site and schema is present; OR no platform could be checked (NO EVIDENCE - do not infer from Google rankings). Always write the line 'Named in X of Y AI answers (platforms; competitors named: ...)' - that exact line seeds the free prospect audit ('Named in 0 of 28').
evidence_sources: ChatGPT (fresh chat, logged out or incognito), Perplexity, Gemini; optionally Claude as in the full audit
geo/money-questions/<niche>.json templates for the exact question wording
Website page source: 'application/ld+json', FAQPage, LocalBusiness, Service schema; any FAQ page
Google Rich Results Test (optional, 30 seconds)
geo/audits/ folders (avoid re-running); geo/src/audit.js full 28-answer run reserved for SEND TODAY leads

dimensions.name: D5. ICP fit and ability to pay (owner-operated, established, high-ticket, niche with a real inquiry leak)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Three tests. (a) OWNERSHIP / SIZE: independently owned, 1-3 locations, no corporate parent, an identifiable owner or principal (phrases like 'family owned', 'locally owned', 'veteran owned', or the owner's surname in the business name help). (b) NICHE NEED: on the current list (med spa / aesthetics, roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, landscaping, generic home services, dental / ortho, PI law, veterinary, fitness, salon / barber, real estate, auto dealers / auto service, restaurants / catering, pet grooming) OR an adjacent niche that passes the need test the bot writes in one sentence to the Sheet's 'Niches' tab before researching it: 'customers call, chat, or submit a form BEFORE buying; the typical sale is $300+ or recurring (LTV $500+); a slow or missed reply loses the sale; and AI assistants name specific businesses for this niche's money questions (test 2 questions once per niche).' Usually pass: tree service, solar, pool service / builders, locksmith, moving, water-damage restoration, towing, chiropractic, physical therapy, IV therapy, dermatology, optometry, family / immigration / estate law, accountants, insurance agencies, mortgage brokers, home health / senior care, wedding venues and photographers, custom builders / remodelers, flooring and kitchen showrooms, tutoring, daycare, funeral homes, mobile mechanics / detailers, and ecommerce with a support phone or chat and consultative or $150+ AOV products (furniture, equipment, custom or made-to-order goods, supplements with questions, B2B supply with a sales line). Usually fail: walk-in coffee shops and convenience retail, food trucks, SaaS, consumer apps, pure info sites, B2B enterprise, dropship or sub-$150-AOV stores with no inquiry flow. (c) ESTABLISHED AND ABLE TO PAY ~$500-$1,500/mo - count proxies, each with a cited source: 3+ years in business ('since YEAR', SOS formation date, license issue date, BBB start date); 20+ Google reviews with 5+ dated in the last 90 days, or 100+ total; visible staff / crew / fleet (3+ named staff or providers, 3+ branded trucks in photos, LinkedIn headcount 2-50); per-customer value >= $1,000 by niche reference (roofing $8-15k; HVAC install $6-12k; plumbing repipe / water heater $1.5-5k; electrical $400-3k; landscaping / hardscape $2-15k; PI law $5k+; dental implants / ortho $3-6k; med spa package $1-5k; cosmetic surgery $5-15k; real estate commission $8k+; auto sale $1k+ gross; solar / remodel $10k+; ecommerce AOV $500+ consult-driven) OR consumer financing offered (Wisetack, GreenSky, CareCredit, Synchrony, Affirm); service area of 3+ cities or counties, or 24/7 emergency service (requires staffing). 15 = (a) and (b) pass AND 3+ ability proxies. 10 = (a) and (b) pass AND exactly 2 proxies; OR 4-9 locations that are clearly owner-run with 3+ proxies. 5 = (a) and (b) pass with 0-1 proxies (solo operator; note 'small budget - lead with Scorecard'); OR an adjacent niche where the need test is plausible but the inquiry channel cannot be cited. 0 = fails (b); OR 10-24 locations; OR owned by PE / holding / DSO / MSO / dealer group (note 'marketing decided elsewhere' so Chosen can decide whether to pursue the group); OR under 1 year old with fewer than 5 reviews and no other proof of being established.
evidence_sources: Website About / Team / Our Fleet / Service Area / Financing / Locations pages and footer ('since YEAR', 'a [Group] company')
Google Maps search of the brand name (count distinct pins); GBP review count, rating, oldest-review date, photos (fleet, storefront)
State Secretary of State registry (formation date, entity type, parent entity, foreign-LLC, DBA); state contractor / professional license lookup (issue date, classification)
BBB profile ('Business Started', 'Incorporated', principal, location count)
LinkedIn company page headcount and People tab; Yelp 'Established in'; Facebook 'Founded'
Pricing / financing / services pages (ticket size, financing partner logos); niche ticket-size reference above (cite the row used)
For ecommerce: platform footer (Shopify / WooCommerce), support phone or chat presence, product-page price points or Google Shopping listings for AOV
News search: '[business name]' + acquired / private equity / joins / partners with; '[brand] franchise'
Google Street View of the listed address (yard, trucks, signage)

dimensions.name: D6. Buying signals: timing trigger and proven marketing spend (reason to talk this month, willingness to pay)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Two sweeps, both logged with what was checked including negatives. TRIGGERS (dated, citable): a job post for receptionist / CSR / dispatcher / front desk / scheduler / office manager; new location or service-area expansion; new website or redesign (Wayback diff, 'new site' post, or domain created < 120 days ago); ownership change, acquisition by an individual, 'under new management', or a new entity filing; a spike of 3+ reviews in 60 days complaining about phone, response, or scheduling; press, award, or 'best of' win; a new Google Business Profile (opened < 6 months, actively collecting reviews); or the vertical's seasonal peak opening NOW with the business advertising for it (HVAC pre-summer / pre-winter, roofing after a storm or in hail season, pool season, back-to-school for dental / ortho, wedding and tax season, Q4 for ecommerce). SPEND signal groups: (a) Google Ads - a Sponsored result for the business on '[core service] [city]' or '[business name]', or a landing page with gclid / UTM / CallRail dynamic number swap; (b) Google LSA - 'Google Guaranteed' or 'Google Screened' badge for '[trade] near [city]'; (c) Meta Ad Library shows ads from the page active in the last 90 days; (d) agency credit or agency platform in footer / source (Scorpion, Hibu, RYNO, LeadHub, Thryv, ReachLocal, Townsquare, PatientPop / Tebra, ProSites, Dealer.com) or GTM + Meta pixel + call tracking (CallRail, CallTrackingMetrics) or Hotjar; (e) paid directories / tools (Yelp Ads, Angi / HomeAdvisor Pro, Thumbtack Pro, Houzz Pro, Zocdoc, RealSelf, Avvo Pro, Cars.com package, Podium, Birdeye, NiceJob, Weave, a paid answering service). 15 = a dated trigger within 60 days AND at least one paid-media signal from (a), (b), or (c). 11 = a trigger within 60 days with no spend found; OR a paid-media signal plus at least one other spend group with no trigger; OR a trigger 61-180 days old plus any spend signal. 7 = exactly one paid-media signal with no trigger; OR a trigger 61-180 days old alone; OR only (d) and/or (e) (pays for web or tools, not lead-gen ads). 3 = only soft activity (monthly social posting, steady review inflow, GBP posts) and no spend signals; OR a seasonal window inferred from the vertical calendar with no business-specific evidence. 0 = nothing found after every mandated search (log the null) - label 'first-agency opportunity' when D2 or D3 is strong, it is not a reject; OR a negative trigger (closing, selling, downsizing, 'not accepting new patients / clients', owner retiring), which also sends the row back through the hard-disqualifier check. Record trigger_type, trigger_date, trigger_url and the five-group spend checklist with explicit negatives. A receptionist / CSR job post is the single best opener E4L has ('you're hiring for the thing the AI answers') - always quote it.
evidence_sources: Google Search, two queries: '[core service] [city]' and '[business name]' (note the Sponsored unit); Local Services Ads unit for '[trade] near [city]' (Google Guaranteed / Screened badge)
Meta Ad Library (facebook.com/ads/library) filtered to the business page, 'active' status
Website footer agency credit; view-source for googletagmanager, fbq(, callrail / calltrk, CallTrackingMetrics, Hotjar; BuiltWith / Wappalyzer-style stack check
Indeed, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn Jobs, Craigslist, Facebook Jobs, site Careers page - business name + city
Google Business Profile Updates / Posts tab, review timeline (count and dates), 'opened' date, dated photos
Wayback Machine homepage snapshots (last change, redesign) and WHOIS / RDAP domain creation date
Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube recent posts (new truck, new location, new hire, grand opening, 'we're hiring')
Local news, patch.com, city business journal, chamber announcements, Google News for the business name; state SOS filings (new entity, amendment, officer change); new license issuance dates
Yelp (Sponsored flag, Yelp Ads badge); Angi / HomeAdvisor / Thumbtack / Houzz / Zocdoc / RealSelf / Avvo / Cars.com listings; chat or review-tool branding on the site
Weather / storm event news for the metro (roofing, HVAC, plumbing) in the last 60 days

dimensions.name: D7. Owner attitude, receptivity, and incumbent stack (how they will treat an AI pitch)
dimensions.scoring_guide: Read how the owner treats customers and whether they already invest in growth; this dimension mainly decides email-first vs. call-first and the tone notes, and never auto-rejects. POSITIVES: (a) the owner or a named manager personally replies to Google reviews, including 1-3 star ones, within about 7 days in a warm, non-defensive voice (read the last 10 replies to negative reviews); (b) modern site - SSL, footer copyright within 2 years, or redesigned within 3 years per Wayback; (c) already adopts tech - online booking, chat, 'text us', consumer financing, review-request tool, modern field / practice software; (d) owner-voiced Instagram / Facebook / TikTok / YouTube / LinkedIn post or GBP post in the last 60 days; (e) growth posture - hiring, 'now serving [new city]', new branding or truck wraps, 'Best of' award, press quote, podcast or interview appearance. NEGATIVES (each cancels one positive): hostile, sarcastic, or defensive replies to reviewers; a pattern of blaming customers; 'we don't use marketing companies' phrasing short of an explicit ban (an explicit ban is a disqualifier); public posts ranting against AI, agencies, or 'marketing scams'; public disputes with prior vendors; copyright 4+ years stale, dead links, or broken SSL; 'cash only'; broken contact form or dead phone number. INCUMBENT STACK: a large bundled vertical agency that supplies call tracking / answering / lead management (Scorpion, Hibu, Thryv, Yodle / Web.com, Townsquare Interactive, RevLocal, 1-800-DENTIST, ProSites, PatientPop / Tebra, Dealer.com, Zillow Premier) or a named in-house marketing manager with a modern stack (HubSpot or GHL, CallRail, SMS automation) is a conflict - note 'GEO wedge only'. Point tools that coexist with E4L (Podium, Birdeye, NiceJob, Housecall Pro, Jobber, ServiceTitan, Weave, Solutionreach, Dentrix, Mindbody, Vagaro, Boulevard, Clio, Follow Up Boss) and a one-person local web designer credit carry no penalty; a DIY builder (Wix, GoDaddy, Squarespace, Weebly) with no agency credit is greenfield. 10 = net 3+ positives and no incumbent conflict. 6 = net 1-2 positives; OR net 3+ positives but a bundled vertical agency or named in-house marketer is present. 3 = net 0 with at least one positive observed; OR passive - no review replies, social dormant 12+ months, homepage unchanged 3+ years, no red flags (often the biggest need, expect slow response; route call-first). 0 = net negative (any hostile / defensive pattern or anti-marketing posts), OR a competing AI receptionist / GEO agency is credited. Whatever the score, write a 2-sentence 'approach_note' for Sebastian, Sam, and Chosen (e.g. 'Owner replies harshly to critics; lead with the free audit, do not open with their reviews') and record the single best 'personalization_hook' (recent post, award, hire, review reply).
evidence_sources: Google Business Profile owner replies (who signs, how fast, tone - especially on 1-3 star reviews); GBP Posts tab

Website footer copyright year, booking / chat / financing widgets; footer 'site by' / 'powered by'; page source meta generator and script domains (podium, birdeye, callrail, intaker, scorpion, hibu, thryv, tebra, mindbody, vagaro)
Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshot frequency and last meaningful change

Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn: post recency, whether the owner appears, topics (growth, hiring, new tech, community); LinkedIn posts and comments by the named owner; LinkedIn employees with Marketing / Growth / Digital titles
Yelp 'From the business' replies; Nextdoor / Reddit mentions of how the owner handles complaints
Job postings naming tools used (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Dentrix, Clio); GBP booking link target domain
Website copy tone ('family story', 'we answer every call', mission statements) and any 'no solicitation' notice; BizBuySell or local news (for-sale or retiring signal)

bands.label: SEND TODAY - demo-ready, goes to the owner now
bands.meaning: A TRUSTED lead with a reachable owner, a cited leak, and ICP fit: it fills today's batch of 10 first (max 4 per niche, max 3 per metro). Before first touch the bot (1) submits the website to the Voice AI demo builder when D2 >= 9 so Sebastian has a live demo number ('demo_build = yes'), or runs the full free GEO audit ('Named in X of 28 AI answers') when D4 >= 6 or the business is form / ecommerce driven ('run_geo_audit = yes'); (2) writes the opening line from the single strongest cited signal (verbatim review quote, receptionist job post, after-hours gap, or the audit line); (3) delivers the full owner dossier (name, role, source URLs, second contact, personalization hook, approach note, best channel) to Chosen for personal outreach. Route: Sebastian email same day when D1 >= 14 AND Sam call within 48 hours; D1 = 8 or DEMO PATH goes call-first to Sam with the demo number, no email slot spent. Loaded to GHL 'E4L Services' from the sheet with tags cold-outreach, niche, city, send-today; every source URL attached to the row.

bands.label: QUALIFIED - load if slots remain
bands.meaning: Worth outreach but weaker on one of reach, leak, or timing. Fills the remaining daily slots after all SEND TODAY leads, ordered by the tie-breakers. One channel chosen from D1: direct email (>= 14) means Sebastian's cold email with the Revenue Leak Scorecard CTA, personalized on the top-cited evidence item (a quoted review, the hours gap, or the growth signal); name-only, generic-mailbox, or DEMO PATH means Sam call on day 1-3 using the owner name. The live demo is built only after a reply, or pre-built if fewer than 5 SEND TODAY leads exist that day. Run the GEO audit only if D4 scored 6 or more; otherwise lead with the Scorecard link. The opener must still cite one specific observation from D2, D3, or D6. Loaded to GHL with tags cold-outreach, niche, city, qualified.

bands.label: WATCH - hold, do not load
bands.meaning: Not sent and not loaded to GHL. Written to the sheet's Watch tab with the lowest-scoring or missing dimension named in 'blocker' and the dimension scores. All PROVISIONAL rows land here regardless of total until the missing evidence is found. If the blocker is D1 (reach), Sam may make a 2-minute 'who handles your marketing?' call to get the owner name or email, then the row is re-scored; if the blocker is D2 / D3, the bot re-researches once using the listed sources; if the blocker is D4, run one GEO money question and re-score. Otherwise re-research in 30-60 days or immediately when a trigger appears (new negative review mentioning calls or response, new receptionist / CSR job post, hours change, site relaunch, review spike). Auto-expires to Rejected after 90 days with reason 'unverified'. A Watch lead Chosen promotes by hand is allowed but logged as 'manual override'.

bands.label: REJECT - log and suppress
bands.meaning: Written to the Rejected tab with the dimension scores and a one-line reason code (which dimensions zeroed and why, or which hard disqualifier fired). Never contacted, never loaded to GHL. The business name, domain, and phone are added to the suppression list the bot checks before researching, and the row is not re-researched for 180 days (chain / franchise, competitor, do-not-contact, and already-in-GHL rejections are permanent). Rejected rows still count toward the daily funnel log (researched / disqualified / watch / qualified / send-today) so that if a niche or city rejects more than 70% of candidates for two consecutive runs the bot proposes dropping or re-targeting it in its daily summary.

minimum_evidence_rule: SCORING ARITHMETIC: total = sum of the seven dimension values; only the listed point values are allowed (no in-between, no averaging), so two runs land on the same number. A dimension with no evidence scores 0 and is labeled NO EVIDENCE; it is never estimated from the niche, a vertical average, or Google rankings. 'Evidence' = a public, clickable URL + a one-line note of what was seen + the date checked, written in that dimension's evidence column. A LOGGED NULL (the bot lists exactly which sources it searched and found nothing, e.g. 'D6: checked Google Ads x2 queries, LSA unit, Meta Ad Library, footer, view-source; none found') counts as evidence for D3, D4, D6, and D7 only, because absence is itself the finding there; 'no ads' alone is not evidence. For D1 only a POSITIVE citation counts (a name or a channel actually found); a null never counts. A score is TRUSTED only when ALL of the following hold: (1) the hard-disqualifier pass was completed and recorded as PASS, including dedupe against the GHL 'E4L Services' sub-account (ghl-contacts.js, by domain, phone, and name + city) and the sheet's Sent / Watch / Rejected tabs; (2) at least 5 of the 7 dimensions carry evidence; (3) D1 is among them with a positive citation (at least a named person or a published direct email); (4) at least one of D2 or D3 has DIRECT evidence (a quoted hours string, a verbatim review, a job post URL), not an inference from the niche; (5) D5 has evidence (otherwise the bot may be scoring the wrong kind of business entirely). If any condition fails, the score is still written, displayed as 'NN / PROVISIONAL' with the missing dimensions listed, the band is capped at WATCH regardless of total, and the lead never enters the daily 10 and gets no band action. If D1 has no positive citation at all, the row is not scored; it goes to Watch with status 'unreachable'. ADDITIONAL GATES: a lead may be placed in SEND TODAY only if 6 or more dimensions have evidence AND the D4 AI spot-check was actually run on at least one platform AND D1 >= 8 (a cited full name with a staffed line or published mailbox) or the row is flagged DEMO PATH (phone-first business, D2 >= 9, named owner, no email - typical med spa / salon). A lead may be loaded to GHL at all only if D1 >= 8 or DEMO PATH, so Rozel's QA is never spent on a business nobody can contact. Any fabricated or pattern-guessed fact (email, owner name, phone, review quote) found at QA invalidates the whole row and returns it to Watch with status 'QA fail'. The bot never calls, emails, or submits a form to the prospect during research. TIME BUDGET per business (target 8 min, hard stop 10), fixed order so weak candidates are abandoned early: 0:00-1:00 hard-disqualifier pass (Places record, GBP status, site loads, chain regex, Maps pin count, dedupe); 1:00-2:00 D5 fit (About / locations / since year / review count / ticket row); 2:00-3:00 D2 phone and hours; 3:00-5:00 D3 reviews / hiring / reply rate / page-source widget scan; 5:00-7:00 D4 three questions x two AI platforms + schema check; 7:00-8:30 D1 owner name and channel (About, SOS, license, LinkedIn, BBB, then email finder); 8:30-9:30 D6 trigger sweep + spend checklist; 9:30-10:00 D7 posture and approach note. Stop the moment a disqualifier fires, and when the clock runs out stop and apply this rule rather than fill in guesses. The 10/day cap is a deliverability rule, not a research cap: the bot may research 25-40 candidates to surface 10 TRUSTED SEND TODAY / QUALIFIED leads and must report the funnel daily. SHEET ROW (one per business, every score column paired with an evidence-URL column so Chosen can audit any score in 30 seconds and map into GHL): identity block (business, niche, city/state, website, main phone, GBP URL, location count, est. year, review count / rating); owner block (owner_name + name_source_url, owner_role, owner_email + email_source_url + email_confidence, pattern_guess_unverified, unconfirmed_name, direct_line, linkedin_url, owner_social, second_contact, owner_public_statements); D1-D7 scores with one quoted observation and URL each; total, band, status (TRUSTED / PROVISIONAL), missing_dimensions; geo_line ('Named in X of Y', platforms, competitors named); strongest_pain_signal (verbatim); trigger_type / trigger_date / trigger_url; spend_signals; vendor_stack; recommended_offer (voice receptionist / missed-call automation / GEO audit / AI-readable site / Scorecard); door_opener (voice demo / GEO audit / Scorecard); demo_build (yes/no); run_geo_audit (yes/no); recommended_opener (drafted line, no promised results, tagline 'AI Marketing Made Easy' only); outreach_route (email-first / call-first / LinkedIn / DEMO PATH); approach_note (tone, 2 sentences); personalization_hook; researched_on; researched_by (bot version); ghl_status (loaded / sent / replied, maintained by the human process). Tabs: Today, Sent, Watch, Rejected, Niches (need-test results and the two money questions used per extended niche), Funnel (daily counts).
tie_breakers: Trust before score: a TRUSTED row always outranks a PROVISIONAL row of any total; within a band, higher total wins.
Trigger recency (D6): the most recent dated trigger wins; a receptionist / CSR / dispatcher job post within 30 days beats every other trigger type because it is the strongest opener E4L has.

Reach quality (D1): 20 beats 14 beats 8; a direct owner email beats a generic mailbox, which beats call-only. When the batch's email slots are the constraint, email-route leads take the slot and call-only leads are handed to Sam without consuming one.
Pain quotability (D3): a row with a verbatim review quote or job post (signal types 1 or 2) beats a row whose leak evidence is only an hours gap, reply neglect, or booking friction.

Door-opener readiness: a phone-first lead where the voice demo can be built today (D2 >= 9, website scrapable) or a GEO lead already 'Named in 0 of 6' (D4 = 10) beats one that needs a reply before anything can be shown.
Niche and metro diversity: max 4 leads per niche and 3 per metro per day; when a cap is hit, the next-ranked lead in a different niche or metro takes the slot so one bad niche cannot fill the batch.

Vertical email hit rate from voice-ai-demo-builder/LEADS_GUIDE.md (trades and real estate first, then law, dental / medical, restaurants; med spa / salon routed DEMO PATH) - applied only when everything above is equal.
Case-study proximity: HVAC and roofing in SoCal, TX, GA, NJ, PA, FL, AZ, NY, IL, and med spa / dental / pet grooming anywhere, edge ahead of equal rows because E4L has reference clients to cite.
Freshness: rows researched within the last 14 days beat rolled-over rows; anything older is refreshed (D3, D6, hours) before it takes a slot.
what_was_taken_from_each_draft: FROM DRAFT 1 (Leak-Signal Rubric v1): the core philosophy 'score the leak, not the logo' with every point tied to a product E4L sells and a ready-made opening line; the phone / after-hours gap dimension almost verbatim (D2), including the urgent-niche list, the 'leave a message' tell, and recording the exact hours string; the six-signal-type leak dimension (D3) built from its D2 review / hiring / reply-rate signals merged with its D3 booking-friction page-source scan (vendor script list kept); the GEO spot-check design (3 of 7 money questions from geo/money-questions, 2 platforms, 'Named in X of Y' line as the audit seed, check geo/audits first, product questions for ecommerce); the one-sentence niche need test and the ecommerce AOV / support-line rule; the DEMO PATH flag so med spa / salon owners without email are routed, not rejected; the 'both fronts covered' version of the AI-receptionist disqualifier (tighter than draft 3's single-front DQ); the 75 / 55 / 35 band cut-offs and the Watch / Rejected tabs with reason codes and the 70%-reject niche-retargeting rule; the 'approach note' requirement on D7; the research-25-to-40-to-surface-10 funnel reporting; and the detailed sheet-column list. FROM DRAFT 2 (PRLS-100): the ability-to-pay lens ($500-$1,497/mo), folded into D5 as a counted-proxy test (tenure, review velocity, team / fleet, footprint, ticket size with its per-niche ticket table and financing-partner tell) rather than a standalone 25-point dimension, which over-weighted size relative to need; the entire marketing-spend checklist (Google Ads queries, LSA badge, Meta Ad Library, agency platforms, pixels and call tracking, paid directories) and the 'first-agency opportunity' label, merged into D6; the 'only listed point values, no in-between' arithmetic rule; the 'documented negative counts only when the sources checked are listed' definition of a logged null; the franchisee-of-any-brand and PE / DSO / MSO ownership disqualifier (preferred over draft 3's score-zero treatment because the franchisor controls marketing, so outreach is pointless); the 90-day recontact and 180-day suppression windows; the extra owner-dossier fields (first-name spelling, second decision-maker, public statements about marketing / phones / AI); the fixed heaviest-first research order and early-stop rule; and the 'never pad the batch, send fewer' principle. FROM DRAFT 3 (RTF-100): the argument that reach must be scored seriously, implemented as the 20-point D1 that merges its Owner Identification and Direct Reach Channel dimensions (two-source confirmation, role-proxy and first-name levels, email-finder confidence thresholds with 'verify before send', the pattern_guess_unverified and unconfirmed_name columns, and the rule that only a positive citation counts for reach); the Trigger Event / Timing concept with its dated trigger list (receptionist job post, redesign, ownership change, review spike, new GBP, seasonal peak) merged with draft 2's spend signals into D6; the Vendor Conflict / incumbent-stack logic (bundled vertical agencies = 'GEO wedge only', coexisting point tools = no penalty, human answering service scored not rejected) folded into D2 and D7; the PROVISIONAL flag with a hard cap at the hold band and the 'unreachable' status; the Niches tab that stores each need-test result and the two money questions so the gate runs once per niche; the per-niche and per-metro daily caps and the trigger-recency / reach / LEADS_GUIDE hit-rate tie-breaker order; the calibration notes (real estate 'owner' = broker-owner, dental 'owner' = the licensed DDS / MD, ecommerce uses the alternate need test and gets speed-to-lead + GEO + FAQ schema); and the rule that Sam records 'who answered' on first call to update the coverage dimension after outreach, never during research. DROPPED OR CHANGED: draft 2's 25-point revenue dimension and 5-point ownership dimension were merged into one 15-point ICP / ability-to-pay dimension; draft 3's 40 points on reach were reduced to 20 because the D1 >= 8 GHL gate already prevents unreachable leads from consuming a slot; draft 1's separate 10-point booking-friction dimension became one signal type inside D3; draft 3's five bands were collapsed to four (its Bench and Weak bands overlap in action); draft 3's single-front AI-receptionist disqualifier was loosened to draft 1's both-fronts version because the free GEO audit is still a live wedge; draft 1's 'no activity 24 months' DQ was tightened to draft 2's 18 months plus a dead phone so a quiet-but-alive business is scored, not rejected.
